issuer: NZ Transport Agency Waka Kotahi (NZTA), through its driver licensing agents
note: Read 2026-10-30 on Drive (drive.govt.nz), NZTA's site for learner drivers; nzta.govt.nz and legislation.govt.nz answered bot checks and weren't read. The full licence is the last of three stages: someone under 25 must be at least 18 (17½ with an advanced driving course, not held) and have held a restricted licence for at least 18 months (12 with the course), and pass a practical test, so the full licence is held from 18; at 25 or over the restricted licence need be held only 6 months. The applicant pays the full licence application fee of $98.90 at a driver licensing agent (most AA offices, some VTNZ stations). The term isn't stated there, so it is null. The page says the Government changes the class 1 licensing system on 25 January 2027; the process held is the one in force until then. No exchange list or identity card was read.

sources.title: Drive (NZTA), Preparing for and booking the full licence test
sources.said: A full licence is the final step of the three-stage process to get a full driver licence. ... be at least 18 years old, or 17½ if you’ve completed an advanced driving course ... have held your restricted licence for at least 18 months, or 12 months if you’ve completed an advanced driving course ... pay the full licence application fee of $98.90 ... These changes happen on 25 January 2027
